text.formatted: A flame, equivalent in brightness to a torch, springs forth from an object that you touch. The effect looks like a regular flame, but it creates no heat and doesn't use oxygen. A _Continual Flame_ can be covered or hidden but not smothered or quenched.
text.plain: A flame, equivalent in brightness to a torch, springs forth from an object that you touch. The effect looks like a regular flame, but it creates no heat and doesn't use oxygen. A Continual Flame can be covered or hidden but not smothered or quenched.

material.text: ruby dust worth 50 gp, which the spell consumes
